codeReview.summary: The feature mostly lands the claimed search improvements, but oversized single-symbol code chunks will duplicate their section labels when tree-sitter splits them again.

issues.description: When `materializeGroups()` recurses into a single large symbol node, it passes `sectionParts` instead of the newly computed `groupSectionParts` into `splitNode()`. `splitNode()` then appends the same symbol again, so large functions/classes can be labeled `file.ts · Foo · Foo` instead of `file.ts · Foo`.

The fallback-ordering regression test does not actually force the LIKE/metadata fallback path; the fixture still allows normal FTS/vector matches, so it would not catch a regression in the code path this feature claims to fix.

summary: Fail: section labels regress for oversized symbol chunks, and the fallback-ordering test does not isolate the fallback path it is meant to verify.
